en.multiphysics.apply_before_run: Apply or cancel the draft before starting a run. The readiness checks describe the committed case.
en.multiphysics.array_entries: {count} entries — edit their exact data in the JSON editor.
en.multiphysics.artifact_hint: Results belong to an immutable input revision. Later edits mark older results as stale.
en.multiphysics.cad_limit: These cases use their explicit numerical representation. General CAD volume meshing and CAD boundary assignment are not connected.
en.multiphysics.case_path: Export the committed case JSON to an explicit local path. The numerical companion can run this file.
en.multiphysics.case_ready: Case structure is ready for worker validation.
en.multiphysics.case_scope: 23 bounded numerical templates are available. Their supported methods and dimensions are explicit in each case.
en.multiphysics.catalog_execution: Source capability record. Only the methods exposed by the runnable case templates are connected here.
en.multiphysics.catalog_hint: Search the audited solver families and their source scope. Catalogue coverage does not enable an execution adapter.
en.multiphysics.conflict: The committed study changed while this draft was edited. Cancel the draft to reload before applying.
en.multiphysics.coupling_preserved: Use a supported coupled numerical template when available. This workspace does not infer field transfers or conservation.
en.multiphysics.coupling_unavailable: General study-to-study coupling is not implemented in this adapter.
en.multiphysics.create_hint: Choose a numerical case template in Studies, then create a study.
en.multiphysics.draft_session_only: Save stores applied values. Unapplied drafts remain only in this open document session.
en.multiphysics.export_busy: An export is running. You can keep editing; wait before starting another export.
en.multiphysics.finish_operation: Finish the current sketch, tool, dialog or file operation before entering Multiphysics.
en.multiphysics.mesh_limit: Edit only the mesh or grid representation supported by this case. No general CAD mesher is connected.
en.multiphysics.name: Name
en.multiphysics.no_artifacts: This result has no retained data artifacts.
en.multiphysics.no_jobs: This study has no numerical jobs in the current session.
en.multiphysics.no_results: No retained results. Run a case and retain its completed output in Run.
en.multiphysics.numeric_preview: The plot and table show at most 2,048 rows and 24 columns. Missing or non-finite samples remain unavailable; export preserves the full original files.
en.multiphysics.preparation_only: Preparation only: no numerical worker is installed for this session.
en.multiphysics.preview_bounded: The text preview is bounded. Export the bundle for the complete data and provenance.
en.multiphysics.question: Question and quantity of interest
en.multiphysics.reproducible: Apply commits one study revision. A run freezes that revision and retains the exact case and its hash.
en.multiphysics.run_hint: Run this committed case in the installed numerical companion.
en.multiphysics.run_identity: Jobs freeze the case and study revision. Retain a completed result to include its evidence in the saved design.
en.multiphysics.settings_hint: Edit the worker’s explicit case fields. Use JSON for arrays, topology and advanced settings; invalid drafts are retained until repaired or cancelled.
en.multiphysics.stale_run: Stale result: this run uses an earlier study revision. It remains historical evidence.
en.multiphysics.units: Case inputs use the companion solver’s SI units, except where the case explicitly declares lattice or normalised quantities. CAD millimetres are not implicitly reinterpreted.
en.multiphysics.validation_boundary: Process completion and numerical convergence do not establish physical validation. Independent measurements and acceptance assessments are not implemented here.
en.multiphysics.verification_hint: Inspect the frozen case hash, solver identity and convergence claims for every retained run.
en.multiphysics.workspace_description: Author numerical studies, run supported solver cases and inspect reproducible results.
en.multiphysics.workspace_stages: Prepare · Physics · Mesh · Couple · Run · Results · Verify
